parameters.query: select (select jsonb_build_object('jurisdiction_code', jurisdiction_code, 'budget_max_minor', budget_max_minor, 'currency', currency, 'budget_period', budget_period, 'radius_m', search_radius_m, 'lat', st_y(anchor_point::geometry), 'lng', st_x(anchor_point::geometry)) from app.profiles where user_id = app.try_uuid($1) and $2::boolean) as profile
